title: Bunk Johnson and George Lewis
summary: Sayles never played with Bunk Johnson or George Lewis; he was in Chicago when Bunk was brought back.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Did you ever play with the bunk or so on?

No, no. I never played with the bunk. No. Well, I remember hearing about him those days and everything, but I mean, I was in Chicago when they picked him up and then he took over with George Lewis Band. I was in Chicago.
How about George? You doing any playing with George?
No, not with his band, but I remember George around there, you know.
